# ml_ventas_envio_comprador fixtures

- `buyer_shipping_capture_20261007.json`: orders, payments, charges and shipments of seven sales, captured from production on 2026-10-07 with personal buyer data stripped.
- `flex_receiver_costs_capture_20261020.json`: the verbatim `ml_shipments_ops.raw_costs` (ML `/shipments/{id}/costs`) of Flex shipments 48267372588 (order 2000018999267608) and 48195392397 (pack 2000015400388457), read-only from production on 2026-10-20.
